description_en: Queries a task that is used to import the backup data of an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket
description_zh: 该接口用于查询SQL Server的某个OSS备份上云任务的信息
name: DescribeMigrateTaskById

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The migration task ID. You can call the DescribeMigrateTasks operation to query the migration task ID
parameters.help_zh: 备份上云任务的ID，可以通过DescribeMigrateTasks接口查询
parameters.name: migrate_task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
